statement: Build a single-page website for CityCare Hospital in Bengaluru allowing patients to book visits and easily find emergency information.
audience: Patients and individuals needing emergency assistance in Bengaluru
standards: Highly visible and legible emergency contact section
Functional and intuitive patient appointment booking interface
Single file HTML layout containing all styling and scripting
rules: Highlight General Medicine, Pediatrics, and Cardiology in the initial booking flow.
Display clear instructions to call 108 for immediate ambulance dispatch.
done_when: The booking system clearly features General Medicine, Pediatrics, and Cardiology.
The emergency helpline '+91 80 4999 9999' and 'call 108' instructions are highly visible on load.
All features run correctly within a single plain HTML/CSS/JS file.
